latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the sex-ai-generator skill.
- Enables transforming a person photo into a bikini model image or video using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires HTTPS access and a WESHOP_API_KEY for authentication.
- Provides endpoints for running jobs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Offers options for output type (video or image), descriptive prompts, and batch generation.
